inventory.description: Pure, host-testable products of Packages/VisualCore: VisualCoreMath, VisualCoreSimulation, VisualCoreScenes, VisualCoreShaderSource, VisualCoreEffectsGraph, VisualCoreDiagnostics, VisualCoreAudioDSP, VisualCorePersistence, VisualCoreParameters, VisualCoreExperience. iOS products of Packages/VisualCoreRendering: VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreEffects, VisualCoreUI, VisualCoreAudio, VisualCoreAutomation, VisualCoreExperienceHost. For Aurora (checked 2026-11-17): VisualCoreRendering has FullScreenShaderScene, ShaderBundle with the vc/ GLSL library (vc_valueNoise, vc_gradientNoise, vc_fbm), FieldPass, ParticleRenderer, ParticleLayerScene and TrailLayer (brightnessCap), ResourceRegistry.makeRenderTarget, PingPongTarget, FloatRenderSupport, CrossfadeScene, CachedScene and RenderCapabilities; VisualCoreEffects has EffectScene; VisualCoreEffectsGraph has FlashLimiterModel and PassSchemas (bloom); VisualCoreShaderSource has RenderState.BlendMode (alpha, premultiplied, additive); VisualCoreScenes has GradientNoise2D and FractalNoise2D; VisualCoreSimulation has ParticleSystem with Emitter, SceneClock and AccessibilityPreferences; VisualCoreDiagnostics has ParticleBudget, FramePacing, DeviceConditions, QualityPolicy and QualityGovernor; VisualCoreMath has ease and EasingCurve; VisualCoreParameters has ParameterSchema, ParameterDefinition, Palette and Preset; VisualCoreExperience has ExperienceSnapshot and ExperienceStorage (setValue); VisualCorePersistence has MigrationChain; VisualCoreAudio has SoundEffectPlayer (one-shot); VisualCoreAudioDSP has SoundEffectSynth; VisualCoreUI has SystemAccessibilityObserver. Missing in every framework product (grep 2026-11-17): a continuous or looping sound player with a volume, a luminance cap for an arbitrary scene, tone mapping, a hide-and-restore or full-screen mode for an experience's controls, a static fallback frame when a shader feature is unsupported, and CPU value noise.

inventory.area: EGL render host and its main-thread rule
inventory.description: RenderHost (@MainActor) owns the EGL display, context and surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend (EGLDisplayProvider), the CAMetalLayer RenderView, the FrameScheduler (CADisplayLink paced by FramePacing: floor 30 frames per second; 30 under Low Power Mode or a serious thermal state, render scale 0.75 when critical; else the presenter's maxFramesPerSecond, 60 by default) and context generations; every GL call runs on the main thread inside RenderScene setup, resize, render and teardown. RenderHost, RenderScene, the presenter, the shell and the action port are main-actor; the core is a Sendable value advanced in fixed steps (ExperienceEngine.advance(frame:)) that never reads a clock or draws. RenderHost pauses in the background, resumes in the foreground, and rebuilds on memory warning and recreateContext. FrameInfo.time is wall-clock; FrameInfo.delta is clamped to 0...0.1 s (FramePacing.clampedDelta).

inventory.area: Shaders and resources (full-screen shaders, GLSL library, render targets and blending, particles, crossfade)
inventory.description: FullScreenShaderScene draws one bundled fragment shader over the canvas with u_time (FrameInfo.time times timeScale, or fixedTime when set), u_resolution, u_seed (seedOffsets), up to 8 palette stops and one float uniform per parameter; a compile error is kept in errorMessage and the frame is cleared to dark grey. ShaderBundle and ShaderLibrary compile bundled GLSL with #include of the vc/ library (noise.glsl: vc_valueNoise, vc_gradientNoise, vc_fbm; hash, palette, color (sRGB), sdf, field). FieldPass runs a fragment program into a render target or over a PingPongTarget; ResourceRegistry.makeRenderTarget creates rgba8, rgba16f or r8 targets under a ResourceBudget, with release, acquireTarget, recycle and trimPools; FloatRenderSupport probes half-float rendering per context generation. RenderState.BlendMode offers none, alpha, premultiplied and additive. ParticleSystem (emitters, forces) under ParticleBudget is drawn by ParticleRenderer as instanced soft quads (ParticleBlend normal or additive) inside ParticleLayerScene, whose brightnessCap (like TrailLayer's) is the only brightness cap. EffectScene runs the effect graph (copy, colorMatrix, blur, bloom, distort, composite, feedback, flashLimit) and, with reduceFlashing, limits the rate of change of mean luminance through FlashLimiterModel (0.3 per second by default). CrossfadeScene mixes two scenes through two lazy RGBA8 targets by a caller-set progress 0...1 (used by Ambient Clock); CachedScene keeps a still frame until its key changes; RenderCapabilities reports fragmentHighp and fragmentMantissaBits.

SceneClock advances only by the frame deltas it is given, each step capped at 0.25 s (maxDelta), with speed 0...4, play, pause, scrub and reducedMotionFactor 0.5; ease and EasingCurve give easing curves. AccessibilityPreferences resolves Reduce Motion and Reduce Flashing against the system (SystemAccessibility, observed by SystemAccessibilityObserver) into EffectiveAccessibility; the app hands them to an experience through ExperienceLaunch.reduceMotion and reduceFlashing (Apps/VisualCore/App/ExperienceRegistry.swift). SoundEffectPlayer plays procedural one-shot SoundEffects rendered by SoundEffectSynth (four voices, at most 1 s each) in the ambient session category with no permission and no player volume, and stops on interruption and in the background (AudioSessionEvent). No continuous or looping player exists.

ExperienceSnapshot (at most 1 MiB, checksum, schema version) with StateDigest; MigrationChain migrates payloads forward and MigrationExample registers stored examples per schema; ExperienceStorage is the experience's own folder and small values (setValue(_:for:), 64 values of 4 KB) under StorageQuota (16 MiB, 64 files). VisualCoreParameters' ParameterSchema, Palette and Preset model bounded parameters. Ambient Clock's ThemePreset and AmbientFavourites are experience-local.

ExperienceSession opens, checkpoints, closes and recovers an Experience on one RenderHost, applies quality (QualityGovernor over the QualityProfile with QualityPolicy, fed by DeviceConditions), memory-warning and scene-phase events and keeps a PerformanceRecord; ExperienceShell adapts an ExperiencePresenter (scene, controls, pointer input, canvas overlay through makeCanvasOverlay, maxFramesPerSecond); ExperienceCore is the GPU-free state with its qualityTiers; the one app registers experiences in ExperienceRegistry and Catalog/registrations.json (twenty registered, A01-A20, candidates empty, checked 2026-11-17; a21 appears in neither and Aurora stays unregistered and unavailable in A21-P00; scripts/check_experience_packages.py forbids unregistered targets). The app shell has no full-screen mode for an experience's controls.

XcodeGen spec project.yml for the one app (target VisualCore), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, app tests via scripts/xcodebuild_app.py, and scripts/release_check.py: 158 lines listed by --list on 2026-11-17 (shared checks including app-contracts, which checks every docs/apps/*/visualcore-contract.json, licenses and usage-descriptions; package and app builds and tests; experience-release and copy-claims steps of the released experiences; verify steps of A01-A20 on iOS 27 and 26; the app's release audits; the seven reference regression steps and the ProjectM independence check). No A21 step exists yet; the A21 copy-claims and verify steps come with G-RELEASE.

Aurora owns its domain (the sky scene: three presets, palettes and the colour, motion and intensity parameters with bounds, versioned and validated; the rendered clock; the ribbon, star and cloud shaders over vc/ at two quality levels; the final composite pass with its explicit luminance cap and comfort bounds; transitions under the cap; saved preferences; the low-power still view, the reduced-flash mode and the static fallback frame; the control overlay that hides and returns; the experience's loop control and its procedural loop; copy) and UI under Packages/ExperiencesCreative/Aurora/ (Core GPU-free, CoreTests, Experience with Adapter/, ExperienceTests, Shaders, scenario-manifest.json; created in A21-P01, not present today). VisualCore owns reusable machinery: full-screen shaders, the GLSL library, render targets, blending, particles and crossfades (VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreShaderSource, VisualCoreEffects), clocks and accessibility (VisualCoreSimulation), pacing and quality (VisualCoreDiagnostics), parameters (VisualCoreParameters), persistence (VisualCorePersistence), storage, snapshots and the host (VisualCoreExperience, VisualCoreExperienceHost), sound (VisualCoreAudio, VisualCoreAudioDSP; the new ambient loop player is G-LOOP). Ambient Clock's themes and crossfade use, Living Wallpapers' scene shaders and Digital Aquarium's caustics stay experience code and are not copied. ProjectM stays in the harness.

Reference pinned at d93edd1, read-only; scripts/run_reference_baseline.py lists the ordered reference steps; scripts/check_reference_clean.py checks the submodule; the 7 release-check steps run in two chunks via release_check.py --only (reference-engine-xcframework, reference-build-projectm-ios-sim, reference-clean; reference-test-anglerendering-ios27, reference-test-anglerendering-ios26, projectm-reference-ios27, projectm-reference-ios26), recorded in docs/apps/aurora/regression-baseline.md. Phase start for the no-change diff of Packages and External: b40fdbee.

StateDigest fingerprints the core state; ScenarioManifest and ScenarioRunner replay recorded steps; QualityProfile levels and QualityGovernor with QualityPolicy and FramePacing step quality and frame cap down under heat and Low Power Mode; ResourceBudget bounds GPU bytes; ParticleBudget bounds particles per tier; ExperienceSnapshot.maxBytes and StorageQuota bound storage; SceneClock.maxDelta bounds a time step.

G-SCENE closed in A21-P01 (SkyScene, SkyPresets; SceneTests, PresetTests). G-SKY closed in A21-P01 (SkyShader aurora-sky.frag, SkyNoise, SkyReference; NoiseTests, SkyRenderTests drawing off screen through FullScreenShaderScene; the presenter of A21-P02 draws it in the app). Available.

matrix.source: manual v0.1 feature 02; manual §13 risk 2; research D4a
matrix.notes: Bounded parameters are tested (ParametersTests, ParameterEditorTests, ExperienceActionTests). The parameter ranges and their validation are G-SCENE (A21-P01); the controls are G-CONTROLS (A21-P02). Numbers are decided with their tests (research D4a). G-SCENE closed in A21-P01 (SkyScene, SkyPresets; SceneTests, PresetTests). G-CONTROLS closed in A21-P02 (SkyCore eight bounded actions, AuroraControls, SkyBlend; AuroraCoreTests, BlendTests). Available.

matrix.capability: Version 0.1 feature 03: scene transitions that never exceed the luminance cap, and saveable preferences
matrix.source: manual v0.1 feature 03; spec clarification Q3
matrix.notes: Tested in CrossfadeSceneTests, EasingTests, ExperienceStorageTests and SnapshotMigrationCheckTests. CrossfadeScene mixes linearly with no cap; transitions with the cap applied after the mix are G-COMPOSITE and saved preferences are G-PREFS (app-local, A21-P03). G-COMPOSITE closed in A21-P03 (SkyTransition over CrossfadeScene, both skies moving and capped, 2.0 s smoothstep; TransitionTests: every step under the limit, the difference from the incoming sky monotonic, context loss and resize mid-change). G-PREFS closed in A21-P03 (SkyPreferences prefs.v1 schema 1 with refusal codes; PreferencesTests, PreferencesStoreTests, SoundChoiceTests). Quality is the host's choice and is not saved. Available.

matrix.capability: Version 0.1 feature 04: a low-power static view and a reduced-flash mode
matrix.source: manual v0.1 feature 04; manual §13 risks 1 and 2
matrix.notes: Tested in FramePacingTests, CachedSceneTests, FlashLimiterModelTests and AccessibilityPreferencesTests. The host lowers the frame rate under Low Power Mode or heat; the experience's still view and reduced-flash mode are G-LOWPOWER (app-local, A21-P04); the long-run cadence on devices is G-DEVICE (A21-P05). G-LOWPOWER closed in A21-P04 (still sky over CachedScene, reduced flashing, fallback sky, released targets; StillViewTests, ReducedFlashTests, FallbackTests, TargetReleaseTests). The missing-highp path is proven through an injectable capability seam; in the app a compile failure triggers the fallback (RenderContext carries no capabilities).

matrix.capability: Version 0.1 feature 05: an optional ambient loop, synthesised in code, with its own sound control (volume 0...1), off by default, independent of the drawing lifecycle
matrix.source: manual v0.1 feature 05; manual §13 risk 3; spec clarification Q4; research D6
matrix.notes: Only one-shot tones exist (four voices of at most 1 s, no player volume; SoundEffectPlayerTests, SoundEffectSynthTests, AudioSessionEventTests). A continuous ambient loop player with a volume is G-LOOP (VisualCore:VisualCoreAudio, upstream, A21-P04); the experience's loop and control are G-SOUND (A21-P05). Never a recording. G-LOOP closed in A21-P04: VisualCoreAudioDSP AmbientLoopRecipe and AmbientLoopSynth, VisualCoreAudio AmbientLoopPlayer (AmbientLoopSynthTests, AmbientLoopPlayerTests), the API baseline updated (23 added), both READMEs, and the reference regression 7 of 7.

matrix.capability: Version 0.1 feature 06: a full-screen view whose controls hide and come back with a tap on the canvas or the accessibility action "Show controls"
matrix.source: manual v0.1 feature 06; spec clarification Q5
matrix.notes: The canvas overlay and pointer delivery are tested (ShellRenderingTests, ShellLifecycleTests); no hide-and-restore or full-screen mode exists and none is added to the shell or host. Hiding and restoring the experience's own overlay is G-CHROME (app-local, A21-P02). G-CHROME closed in A21-P02 (AuroraControls hide and restore by a tap or the accessibility action Show controls; ChromeTests). Available.

matrix.capability: Luminance cap: an explicit cap on displayed luminance in a final composite pass, with comfort bounds on ribbon frequency and brightness, applied after every mix
matrix.source: spec FR-A21-003; spec clarification Q3; manual §13 risk 2
matrix.notes: A brightness cap exists only on TrailLayer and ParticleLayerScene (ParticleLayerSceneTests, TrailLayerTests); FlashLimiterModel limits a rate, not a level. A cap for an arbitrary scene is G-CAP (pure math and a composite pass, app-local, A21-P02) and its use under transitions is G-COMPOSITE (A21-P03); the value is decided with its tests (research D4a). Moved upstream only when a second experience needs it. G-COMPOSITE closed in A21-P03 (SkyTransition over CrossfadeScene, both skies moving and capped, 2.0 s smoothstep; TransitionTests: every step under the limit, the difference from the incoming sky monotonic, context loss and resize mid-change).

Available.

G-SKY closed in A21-P01 (SkyShader aurora-sky.frag, SkyNoise, SkyReference; NoiseTests, SkyRenderTests drawing off screen through FullScreenShaderScene; the presenter of A21-P02 draws it in the app). G-COMPOSITE closed in A21-P03 (SkyTransition over CrossfadeScene, both skies moving and capped, 2.0 s smoothstep; TransitionTests: every step under the limit, the difference from the incoming sky monotonic, context loss and resize mid-change). Available.

gaps.justification: The sky scene (three presets, palettes, the colour, motion and intensity parameters with their bounds), its schema, validation and migration are the experience's domain, GPU-free in its Core (manual phase 01). No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Core host tests: each preset round-trips and migrates; truncated, newer, NaN, infinite and out-of-range values refused or clamped to the declared bounds; every action stays within 24 values; the digest is stable for the same inputs

gaps.justification: The aurora ribbon (slowly advected fbm colour bands), starfield (hashed, bounded twinkle) and cloud (fbm layers) shaders over vc/, drawn as 2D FullScreenShaderScene passes at two quality levels and rebuilt after resize and context loss (manual phase 01, risk 1). No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Experience tests: every shader compiles through ShaderBundle; each preset renders non-empty and within its declared brightness range on the iOS 27.x simulator; level 1 draws fewer octaves than level 0; passes rebuild after recreateContext and resize with the same output; license inventory lists the shaders

gaps.justification: The rendered clock (SceneClock advanced by frame deltas into FullScreenShaderScene.fixedTime, never FrameInfo.time) and the reduced-motion stable frame are the experience's policy (spec clarification Q3). No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Core and experience tests: a long background gap advances rendered time by at most SceneClock.maxDelta; Reduce Motion gives the same frame on consecutive draws; the shader time equals the clock time

gaps.justification: Scene selection and the colour, motion and intensity controls with their bounds, VoiceOver labels and Dynamic Type layouts are the experience's interface (manual phase 02).
gaps.test: Experience tests: each control maps to a bounded parameter and refuses values outside it; every control has a label and an adjustable action; layouts hold at the largest Dynamic Type size

gaps.justification: No luminance cap for an arbitrary scene and no tone mapping exist in VisualCore (brightnessCap is only on TrailLayer and ParticleLayerScene). The cap as pure math in Core and the final composite pass applying it, with comfort bounds on ribbon frequency and brightness, are experience code (spec clarification Q3, manual risk 2). No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Core host tests: the cap function never returns luminance above the declared cap for any input, including NaN and infinity; ribbon frequency and brightness stay within the comfort bounds; experience tests: a read-back of the composite never exceeds the cap

gaps.justification: No hide-and-restore or full-screen mode exists for an experience's controls, and none is added to the shell or host. The experience's control overlay hides on request and returns with a tap on the canvas or the accessibility action "Show controls" (spec clarification Q5). No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Experience tests: hiding removes the overlay and never changes the state; a canvas tap or the "Show controls" accessibility action restores it; VoiceOver can always reach the action

gaps.justification: Multi-layer compositing (ribbons additively over stars and clouds) and preset transitions through CrossfadeScene with the cap applied after the mix, rebuilt after resize and context loss (manual phase 03). No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Experience tests: at every progress step of a transition the read-back stays under the cap; the mix is monotonic in progress; composite targets rebuild after recreateContext and resize

gaps.justification: Saved preferences (preset, parameters, quality, sound choice) in the experience's storage values with a schema and migration (manual phase 03).
gaps.test: Experience tests: preferences round-trip through ExperienceStorage.setValue within StorageQuota; damaged or newer values are reported and replaced by defaults, not fatal; a schema above 1 has registered examples; the sound setting is stored with the preferences and stays independent of the drawing lifecycle (manual Phase 03 fixture)

gaps.justification: A continuous speaker-output loop is generic and VisualCore has only one-shot tones (spec clarification Q4, research alternatives). VisualCoreAudio gains an ambient loop player: the ambient session category, its own volume 0...1, stopped on interruption and in the background, playing a procedural buffer rendered by VisualCoreAudioDSP; with /// documentation, tests, the API baseline update and the seven-step reference regression in two chunks (CLAUDE.md rule 13).
gaps.test: Package tests: the loop's buffer is deterministic, finite, within ±gain and seamless at the loop point; volume is clamped to 0...1; the player stops on interruption and background events and uses the ambient category; API baseline updated; reference regression 7 of 7

gaps.justification: The low-power still view (CachedScene over the host's FramePacing), the reduced-flash mode, the static fallback frame when a shader fails or highp is missing (RenderCapabilities), and release of GPU targets on preset changes are the experience's policy (manual phase 04, spec clarification Q3). No fallback frame exists in VisualCore. No VisualCore change is planned (spec clarification Q3); a second user would justify moving it upstream later (Principle II).
gaps.test: Experience tests: the still view draws the child once until its key changes; the reduced-flash mode keeps frame-to-frame luminance change under the declared limit; a forced compile failure or missing highp shows the fallback frame, not grey; target bytes return to the baseline after preset changes

gaps.justification: The experience's optional ambient loop over the G-LOOP player, with its own control and volume, off by default and independent of the drawing lifecycle (manual phase 05; spec clarification Q4).
gaps.test: Experience tests: sound is off by default; the volume control maps to 0...1; pausing, hiding or rebuilding the drawing never starts or stops the loop; sound never changes the digest

gaps.justification: Long-run thermal behaviour, visual comfort and the low-power cadence without a time jump are measured on devices after ImplementationLock-100 (manual phase 05; short runs bounded by arithmetic).
gaps.test: Device-campaign rows: thermal state and frame rate over a short run per preset, extrapolated; low-power cadence shows no time jump; the luminance cap and comfort bounds verified on screen; no figure claimed unless measured

gaps.justification: The A21 copy-claims and verify release steps and the release notes are repository tooling for this experience (manual phase 06).
gaps.test: Release-check steps: copy-claims-a21 finds no forecast, scientific, therapeutic, sleep, always-on-screen or unmeasured performance claim; verify-a21 steps pass on the iOS 27.x and 26.x simulators

negative.rule: Risk 1, expensive volumetric layers drain battery. Owner: the 2D layered sky shaders at two quality levels (app-local G-SKY in A21-P01), the low-power still view (G-LOWPOWER in A21-P04) and the device measurements (G-DEVICE in A21-P05). Verification: experience tests prove every layer is a 2D full-screen pass, level 1 draws fewer octaves than level 0 and the still view draws once until its key changes; a source scan finds no volumetric ray-march loop; the device campaign records thermal state and frame rate over a short run per preset, extrapolated. Release blocker: a volumetric layer, no quality level below full, no low-power view, or a battery or thermal figure not measured on a device.

Risk 2, bright flashing imagery. Owner: the luminance cap and comfort bounds (app-local G-CAP in A21-P02), transitions under the cap (G-COMPOSITE in A21-P03), the reduced-flash mode (G-LOWPOWER in A21-P04) and Reduce Motion and Reduce Flashing (G-CLOCK in A21-P01, via ExperienceLaunch). Verification: Core tests prove the cap function never exceeds the cap and ribbon frequency and brightness stay within the comfort bounds; experience tests prove composite read-backs stay under the cap at every transition step and frame-to-frame luminance change stays under the declared limit with Reduce Flashing; the device campaign checks on screen. Release blocker: any frame above the cap, a transition exceeding it, a flash above the declared rate, or Reduce Motion or Reduce Flashing ignored.

Risk 3, soundtrack licensing. Owner: the ambient loop player (VisualCore:VisualCoreAudio G-LOOP in A21-P04) and the experience's synthesised loop and control (app-local G-SOUND in A21-P05). Verification: package tests prove the loop buffer is rendered in code by VisualCoreAudioDSP; scripts/check_licenses.py and a resource scan find no bundled audio file; the license inventory lists the synthesised loop. Release blocker: any bundled or downloaded recording, a sound without a license entry, or sound on by default.

reasons: A working host exists: RenderHost on OpenGL ES -> ANGLE -> Metal (main-actor) draws any RenderScene, paced by FramePacing under Low Power Mode and heat, with pause in the background and recreateContext, all public and tested (RenderHostTests, FramePacingTests, SessionLifecycleTests).

Full-screen shader drawing exists: FullScreenShaderScene with fixedTime, timeScale, palette and parameters, ShaderBundle with the vc/ noise, hash and palette library, and FieldPass, as Ambient Clock, Living Wallpapers and Digital Aquarium use (FullScreenShaderSceneTests, ShaderBundleTests, FieldPassTests).

Additive compositing into render targets exists: RenderState.BlendMode.additive, ResourceRegistry.makeRenderTarget, PingPongTarget, FloatRenderSupport, ParticleLayerScene, CrossfadeScene, CachedScene and FlashLimiterModel (RenderStateTests, CrossfadeSceneTests, FlashLimiterModelTests); SceneClock gives a rendered time apart from wall-clock time (SceneClockTests).

10 of 26 rows are available with tests; all 16 non-available rows have owned gaps: G-SCENE, G-SKY and G-CLOCK in A21-P01; G-CONTROLS, G-CAP and G-CHROME in A21-P02; G-COMPOSITE and G-PREFS in A21-P03; G-LOOP (VisualCore:VisualCoreAudio, upstream) and G-LOWPOWER in A21-P04; G-SOUND and G-DEVICE in A21-P05; G-RELEASE in A21-P06. The only VisualCore change is G-LOOP; the luminance cap, fallback frame and hide-and-restore controls stay app-local (spec clarifications Q3 to Q5).

No permission is needed (sound is ambient and synthesised, nothing uses location). Aurora stays unregistered (20 registered, A01-A20) until A21-P01 creates Packages/ExperiencesCreative/Aurora with its targets and first real rules.
